ACTION: Read `skills/cache-invalidation/SKILL.md` to see the current purge-vs-expire guidance and where a flowchart would fit.
ACTION: Read `specs/cache-invalidation-baseline.md` to get the reps' reasons for purging verbatim, so the decision nodes are built from them.
ACTION: Read `~/.claude/skills/writing-skills/references/flowcharts.md` for the rules on when a flowchart belongs and the graphviz style and render tool.

I'm reading before I edit, because the flowchart's questions have to come from what the agents actually said. The 11 of 15 wrong purges are the failure to fix. I'll make each decision node a yes/no question about something the agent can check, such as whether the data is stale and wrong or only old, or whether anything depends on it being gone now. I'm using that form because the agents knew the options and picked wrong, so a conditional fits better than a "don't purge unless..." rule.

Once I've read the three files, I'll add the flowchart to `skills/cache-invalidation/SKILL.md`. I'll render it with the tool from flowcharts.md to confirm it's valid. Then I'll show you the diff and re-run the same three scenarios, 5 reps each, with the skill in place, to check whether the purge rate drops from 11 of 15.
